LENG.description: Unbraced Length (LENG). Member unbraced-length data for Japan Road (Steel, Part II) steel design; all fields are optional overrides of the element's computed unbraced lengths.

LY.description: Unbraced length Ly for buckling about the y-axis (weak-axis).

LZ.description: Unbraced length Lz for buckling about the z-axis (strong-axis).

LB.description: Laterally unbraced length Lb used for lateral-torsional buckling checks.

bNOTUSE.description: If true, the laterally unbraced length is not considered.

bAUTOCALC.description: If true, the unbraced lengths are calculated automatically by the design code.

LT.description: Torsional unbraced length Lt used for torsional buckling checks.
